'''Njanner-Pok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing in the city of [[Mos Ila]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], he managed a vendor stand and sold [[Armor/Legends|armor]].
